description: This file defines the vardefs (variable definitions) for the FP_events module in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM project. It specifies the fields, relationships, and metadata for the FP_events entity, including attributes like date, duration, links, and associations with other entities.

methods.name: VardefManager::createVardef
